content.text:
**Findings so far**

The expanding-window standardized V03 signal failed. Its mean rank IC was essentially zero and its HAC t-statistic was about -0.1. Coverage was only 0.73, and it overlapped moderately with the base features. It looked negative in low-T regimes and strongly positive in high-T regimes, with the sign flipping between them. That suggests a regime dependence, but it is one observation and not confirmed.

The six-month persistence signal for V05 was also unsuccessful. Its IC was -0.07 and its t-statistic was -1.82, the opposite of the hypothesized sign. It was negative in both T regimes, had almost no overlap with the base features, and was very slow-moving (rank autocorrelation 0.83).

**Next step**

Try the reversed sign of V05 persistence, or condition V03 on T regimes.
